scope: Isolated read-only feedback injection -> backend -> real Unity; no physical PLC connection or writes; installed player not replaced

backend.failure: admin-auth isolated configuration-file persistence failed once; original failure retained; unchanged test passed 17 groups on standalone retry; underlying errno unavailable

unityChecks: real CAD transfer cart feed action binds only the two guaranteed read-only BOOL points through the actual data-center save API
native initialization shows the actually confirmed retracted CAD pose, without replaying a fictitious stroke
both-off only waits; no timer invents intermediate position or confirms a successful transfer
healthy endpoint confirmation drives the actual CAD carriage, gear and return-chain channels using the same sampled package as the management preview
both-on feedback conflict freezes actual geometry and is not interpreted as two successful stages
bad/stale sources freeze geometry; fresh recovery reads the latest endpoint directly rather than continuing a disconnected display timer
adding a current model component action and binding existing data makes it play in the same Unity process without recompile or restart
editing the component action output updates its actual native transform live, while the existing CAD feed remains correct
component deletion removes the actual native action; explicit re-add/rebind and rapid edits apply only the final authoritative definition
sixteen real native source/receive/first-transform observations measure latency separately from the intentional display transition
targeted model/action refresh preserves the same factory, hall, camera, current view and unrelated furnace roots; paired specific/generic events do not cause a full reload
adding, editing and deleting component actions never re-download/import the unchanged all-node-preserved CAD rig; independent renderers and the actual endpoint clip remain available
latencyScope: 100ms isolated read-only injection -> backend motion inputs -> real Unity transform; not a PLC/collector end-to-end measurement
notes: Screenshots are original JPEG capture bytes, not composited or generated images.
51% is frozen display interpolation for demonstration, not measured physical position.
